title: Fix three bugs in a Go singly linked list
description: A singly linked list has three bugs: Append always inserts at head, Len counts one too many, Contains returns true when node is nil.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in linkedlist.go:
1. `Append`: walk to tail (`curr.Next != nil`), then set `curr.Next = &Node{Val: val}`; handle empty list (set head directly)
2. `Len`: start `count := 0` instead of 1
3. `Contains`: change `return true` at the bottom to `return false`
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
